Incidence R&D

Innovation
AMDAL/environmental management
Waste management.

unit_of_analysis: Source observation keyed by source_year/source_row; annual grouped aggregates. No longitudinal identity is needed for these cross-sectional summaries.

decisions.alternatives: No silent alternative; amendment requires a versioned review before execution.
decisions.sensitivity: Only the registered variants, each saved with scenario_id.
